name: Bosphorus Records
description: Where Europe meets Asia, White Silence launders its money through a shipping company on the Bosphorus. Its records office holds the next password. Run the crane catwalk over the harbour past the dock guards and shoot your way through the office, or dive in and swim: hack the doors on two sluice piers with USB keys from the seabed and swim on into the flooded cellar. Both routes climb the stairwell to the archive.
